site_title: MAIC-DB — Mechanically Activated Ion Channel Database
home_tagline: A curated database for mechanically activated ion channels — every number one click from its measurement row and verbatim evidence quote.
card_zero_rows_note: no curated rows — reported, not hidden
sign_convention_note: values are as recorded (negative P50 = suction; K2P layers all-negative); no |value| pooling is performed (data notes §6.1)
card_qualitative_note: qualitative as-reported rows belong to no parameter block
downloads_intro: The complete data artifact, byte-identical to the Zenodo record — every number on this site traces back to these files.
downloads_doi_concept_label: Concept DOI (always resolves to the latest release)
downloads_unmapped_note: archived unmapped measurement rows — kept for provenance, mapped to no registered parameter block, with no page of their own on this site; disclosed here by count (see the load manifest in the Zenodo record)
parameters_index_intro: Cross-family comparison — one page per registered parameter, every channel listed with count/min/median/max per stored unit.
param_unit_disclosure: Buckets are split by stored unit: values are rendered as recorded, units are never merged or converted (unit normalization is a human curation decision pending a future data release).
ratio_median_note: median omitted: ratio_direction is NULL on every row this load, and cross-direction medians are meaningless (A1 panel p4 semantics — direction-unstated groups report count/min/max only)
footer_ai_disclosure: Substantial literature mining, code implementation, and review preparation was executed by AI agents under human direction; every merge passed an independent review gate.
